response.title: which solar generator for camping is the lightest that still runs a cooler
response.answer:
For camping, the lightest solar generator that can reliably run a cooler depends on whether you have an electric compressor cooler or a traditional cooler.

If you're using a 12V electric compressor cooler (like an ICECO, Dometic, or BougeRV), I'd target a portable power station weighing under 8 lb, with at least 250Wh of battery capacity.

A 250Wh battery can typically run an efficient 12V cooler for around 8–15 hours, depending on ambient temperature, cooler size, and how frequently the compressor runs.

The important distinction is that a solar generator is really a battery power station with optional solar panels. The panel adds weight, so I'll compare the battery units separately.

Best lightweight options

Jackery Explorer 300D Portable Power Station

A particularly lightweight choice, but confirm that your cooler accepts its available DC/USB-C outputs.

$239.99

Compact alternative with USB-C outputs; check cooler connector compatibility.

7.7 lb · 245Wh · AC and 12V car outlet

$239.00

Slightly heavier, but easier to use with common camping refrigerators.
